name: Jailer Vifil

facts.text: Jailer Vifil is a level-82 hrimthursa with 100,000 health who calls two hrimathursa tormentors from his tunnels.
He sends a player to a fixed spot in the tunnels away from the fight, as if to a cell.
Bot chat has a rumour that he holds one of the Troll Fathers in a cell, and says he keeps a cell for every enemy the queen has named.
Vifil (Vifill) is an Old Norse personal name (to verify).

story: Vifil keeps the south tunnels and the cells cut into them. There is a cell, they say, for every enemy Queen Kula has ever named, and most of them are full. He does not trouble to fight everyone who comes. He takes one of you by the collar and puts you somewhere else, deep in the tunnels where his tormentors walk, and then he turns back to the rest. The rumour that he keeps a Troll Father down there has outlived every raid that tried to check. Vifil has never denied it. He has never said anything at all about his prisoners, which is why the rumour lives.
legend: When Vifil ports you, you land in the tunnels on your own. Don't fight the tormentors alone, run back to the raid. Keep someone ready to rez the ones he sends away. And no, nobody has found the Troll Father. Yet.

aggro: Another for the cells. There is always room.

phases.text: You. Down the tunnel. Wait there.

death: The keys... someone take the keys...

lairEntry: Barred cells are cut into the ice. Some are occupied.

phases.text: Jailer Vifil drags someone into the tunnels!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Jailer Vifil is dead. The cells stand open.

briefing: vifil ports people into his tunnels. if its you, run back, dont fight the tormentors alone
aftermathWin: vifil down. anyone check the cells for the troll father? [no?|lol]
aftermathLoss: he ported both MTs and that was that
rumour: the jailer up there has a troll father locked away, my [guild|gran] swears
[i heard|heard] vifil keeps a cell for every enemy kula ever named

loremasterTopic.text: The queen's jailer, with a cell for every enemy she has named. He takes one of you by the collar and puts you deep in his tunnels. Some say a Troll Father sits in one of his cells. He has never said otherwise.

bookPage: Inventory of the south cells, as I was told it by a kobold who escaped them, which I do not believe and write down anyway. Twelve cells of the first row: dwarves. Nine of the second: Svartalfar who came to trade and stayed. Three of the third: men of Jordheim. One at the end, set apart, with a door twice the height of the others, which the jailer visits every morning and from which no sound ever comes. The kobold swore the door was cut for something wider than a giant. Then he asked for more ale.
